description: This file defines the Psr17Factory class which implements multiple PSR-17 factory interfaces to create HTTP message objects such as requests, responses, streams, uploaded files, and URIs. It provides concrete methods for creating these objects using various parameters.

classes.name: Psr17Factory
classes.description: A final PHP class implementing multiple PSR-17 factory interfaces to produce HTTP message objects and related entities.

methods.name: createRequest
methods.description: Creates a new Request object with the given HTTP method and URI.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Creates a new Response object with an optional status code and reason phrase.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a new Stream object from a string content.

methods.name: createStreamFromFile
methods.description: Creates a Stream object from a file, given filename and mode.

methods.name: createStreamFromResource
methods.description: Creates a Stream object from an existing resource.

methods.name: createUploadedFile
methods.description: Creates an UploadedFile object from a stream, size, error status, filename, and media type.

methods.name: createUri
methods.description: Creates a Uri object from a given URI string.

methods.name: createServerRequest
methods.description: Creates a ServerRequest object with method, URI, and server parameters.
